Hotels & Places

The hotels and cities at the center of the research, with uncertain associations kept distinct from verified ones.

Zürich · Hotel

Savoy-Baur en Ville

  • Previously verifiedCLAIM-SAVOY-1911

    Earlier research found a 1911 advertisement identifying S. H. Gottlieb as director of Baur en Ville or Savoy.

    Sources: SRC-003
  • Verified directCLAIM-BAUR-POSTCARD

    A cataloged promotional postcard associates the wording 'Direktion S.H. Gottlieb' with Baur en Ville.

    Sources: SRC-002
  • Verified directCLAIM-SAVOY-1922

    A 1922 Swiss travel guide lists S. H. Gottlieb as director of Savoy-Baur en Ville in Zürich.

    Sources: SRC-001
  • Indexed leadCLAIM-BAUR-BIBLOS-OCR

    Indexed OCR from a Biblos Repository source places 'S. H. Gottlieb, Direktor' near a Baur en Ville entry.

    Sources: SRC-004
  • Conflicting evidenceCLAIM-SAVOY-SECONDARY-DUFFING-1909-1910

    A secondary Savoy history assigns Hermann Duffing a management period from 1909 to 1910.

    Sources: SRC-018
  • Conflicting evidenceCLAIM-SAVOY-SECONDARY-GOTTLIEB-1910-1918

    A secondary Savoy history assigns a management period from 1910 to 1918 to 'I. Gottlieb'.

    Sources: SRC-018
  • Conflicting evidenceCLAIM-SAVOY-SECONDARY-GIGER-1918-1926

    A secondary Savoy history assigns Fritz Giger a management period from 1918 to 1926.

    Sources: SRC-018
  • Catalog verifiedCLAIM-SAVOY-CENTENARY-1938

    Hans Schulthess's 64-page illustrated Savoy centenary history was published in Zürich in 1938 and is cataloged by the Wolfsonian.

    Sources: SRC-010

Caution: The management chronology contains an unresolved conflict between direct 1922 evidence and a secondary timeline.

Zürich · Hotel

Grand Hotel Victoria

  • Needs recheckCLAIM-GRAND-VICTORIA-1924

Baden-Baden · Hotel

Hotel Messmer

  • Indexed leadCLAIM-MESSMER-1929

    Marketplace metadata indicates that a 1929 Hotel Messmer advertisement associated with Gottlieb exists.

    Sources: SRC-007
  • Previously verifiedCLAIM-MESSMER-C1932

    Earlier research found a circa 1932 telephone-directory entry naming S. H. Gottlieb as Inhaber of Hotel Messmer.

    Sources: SRC-008
  • Previously verifiedCLAIM-MESSMER-1934

    Earlier research found a 1934 telephone-directory association between Hotel Messmer and S. H. Gottlieb.

    Sources: SRC-009

Caution: Do not infer ownership of the property, residence at the hotel, or an exact tenure from the current evidence.
